description: Tuned Delay Line by Frequency: a very short stereo delay whose length is one cycle of the pitch at its V/Oct input, for Karplus-Strong and flanging patches

params.text: Offsets the delay pitch; type in a whole number to move it by that many octaves.
Shortens the delay by a whole number of samples, from 0 to 20, to make up for the one sample each patch cable in the feedback loop adds.

inputs.text: The left channel into the delay line.
The right channel into the delay line; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels.
Sets the delay length at 1V per octave: 1000Hz gives a delay of 1ms, 100Hz a delay of 10ms.

notes: there is no feedback path inside the module, so a mixer is needed to send the output back to the input; that loop is what makes the plucked-string sound.
